# Third-party source

`twitter-text-3.1.0.js` is the unmodified official Twitter text parser distribution (version 3.1.0).

- Source commit: `30e2430d90cff3b46393ea54caf511441983c260`
- Source: https://github.com/twitter/twitter-text/blob/30e2430d90cff3b46393ea54caf511441983c260/js/pkg/twitter-text-3.1.0.js
- License: Apache-2.0; see [TWITTER-TEXT-LICENSE](TWITTER-TEXT-LICENSE).

It is included to validate Unicode, emoji, bare domains, and HTTPS URLs offline. The wrapper in `scripts/x_lengths.js` is archive-specific; the third-party distribution itself is unchanged.
